steps.description: The experience guides conversion without hiding limits, retention or responsibility for the file.

trust.title: Privacy, accessibility and responsible use in one flow
trust.description: V2.0 reinforces important parts of a real SaaS product: private files, account-protected downloads, clear retention, bilingual support and simple messages.

privacy.title: Private by product design

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms explain, in plain language, how to use Convertly responsibly. They are not a full legal policy and may evolve as the product grows.
terms.relatedText: See also the content and copyright policy:

whatConvertlyDoes.title: What Convertly does
whatConvertlyDoes.text: Convertly helps you convert DOCX documents into PDF files inside your account, with usage and retention limits defined by your plan.

userResponsibility.title: Responsibility for files
userResponsibility.text: You should only upload files that you have the right to use, convert and download. Do not upload third-party content without permission.

allowedUse.title: Allowed use
allowedUse.text: Use Convertly for legitimate document conversions. The service should not be used to distribute illegal content, expose private data or bypass access controls.

privateFiles.title: Private files
privateFiles.text: Uploaded files are not made public by Convertly, are not shared between accounts and remain associated with the authenticated person.

retention.title: Plan-based retention
retention.text: Files and downloads remain available during the retention period for your plan. After that, downloads may expire.

serviceLimits.title: Service limitations
serviceLimits.text: Convertly aims to provide a stable experience, but does not promise absolute availability, perfect conversion for every document or recovery of expired files.

futureContact.title: Future contact and reports
futureContact.text: A dedicated contact, report and removal flow may be implemented in a future phase.

copyright.title: Content and copyright policy
copyright.intro: Convertly respects copyright and expects everyone to use the product with the same care.
copyright.relatedText: Read the terms of use too:

rights.title: Right to use
rights.text: Only upload files that you created, own, are authorized to use or may convert according to applicable rules.

privateFiles.title: Files are not public
privateFiles.text: Convertly does not publish uploaded files and does not provide public upload in this phase.

noIndexing.title: No indexing
noIndexing.text: Uploaded files are not prepared for public search or indexing by external search engines.

noSharing.title: No sharing between accounts
noSharing.text: Files from one account are not shared with other accounts inside the product.

protectedDownloads.title: Protected downloads
protectedDownloads.text: Downloads require authentication and respect conversion ownership, so each account can access only its own files.

retention.title: Expiration and retention
retention.text: Converted files expire according to the retention period for the plan. History records may remain available for reference.

futureRemoval.title: Future removal flow
futureRemoval.text: A formal report, review and removal flow may be created later. In this phase, the product only communicates responsible use rules.
